opus.problem: This clue says nearly the same thing as clue 1: Israel was commanded to live in these. Nehemiah 8:14 only restates the Mosaic command from Leviticus 23:42. Clues 5 to 7 already cover the Nehemiah story, so this clue adds no new fact.

All 7 clues come from just two passages (Leviticus 23:39-43 and Nehemiah 8:14-17). Well-known uses are missing, such as Jesus going up to the Feast of Tabernacles in secret (John 7), Jacob making booths at Succoth (Genesis 33:17), the nations going up yearly to keep the feast (Zechariah 14:16), and the Law read aloud at the feast every seventh year (Deuteronomy 31:10-11). This goes against 'Known stories first' and leaves little variety among the clues.
